<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Zephyr Slip](/Spells.aspx?ID=1327)
<actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Move" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=114" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 73

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Trigger** A creature enters a space within 5 feet of you.

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

An arresting breeze sweeps you up in an instant and moves you to safety. You [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=94) 15 feet directly away from the triggering creature.

---
**Heightened (6th)** You and one adjacent ally Fly up to 25 feet directly away from the triggering creature.

**Heightened (8th)** You and up to 5 allies within 30 feet Fly up to 25 feet directly away from the triggering creature.
name: Zephyr Slip
